name: John Alexander Hamilton
milestones: Married Eleanor Philpott (Hamilton) (m. 22 Jun 1795, Frederick County, MD)
sources: Hamilton family register (The Family of Francis Hamilton and Susan), in Bill Allen’s Further Research (February 2012)
notes: Register number 158.1. In 1808 he bought 46 acres of the family estate from his sister Jacobina. Received slaves, silver and a share of land-sale proceeds from his uncle Alexander in 1790.
